scope: Live private Photon room: rendered Editor host and two independent Realtime peers. Verifies transport, sender ownership, shared progress, late join and host handoff. Remote rendered UI and physical Android are not verified.

Wrong membership grades red, deducts exactly ten seconds and attributes the authenticated sender
Replay cannot add a second Sets penalty or mistake
Late join restores physical IDs, review colors and exact deadline
A guest cannot forge a completed Sets snapshot

Photon shares membership problem 6

A forged dormant copy ID is rejected even beside its supply
